Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a technical methodology validation study (blind test) rather than a differential proteomics experiment. The goal was to generate distance constraints for protein structure prediction, not to compare biological conditions. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified. The cross-linker (sulfo-SDA) and UV irradiation are part of the analytical sample preparation/assay protocol for CLMS, not biological perturbations.
